patch_list: Silences the Firebase Analytics event and user-property paths and switches off Google measurement, Crashlytics and Sessions upload, and advertising and install-referrer permissions in the manifest. Gameplay and Play Games sign-in keep work…

Turns the ad support flag off, exactly like the game does on televisions and in cars. No ad SDK is initialized, no consent screen or age check appears, and every interstitial and rewarded request follows the game's own 'unavailable' path.

Declares Beach Buggy Racing a parked game app, so Android Auto and car hosts like DriveDeck and Gearslip list it on the car screen by themselves. Android Auto still needs Unknown sources in its developer settings for a patched app.
